reason: Only partly as stated, and not new: InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:103 passes a possibly-null storedIdp to registerIDPInvalidation, which dereferences it at :366, but only when the alias cache key is already invalidated in the session (before the patch the same line passed idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias) inline). The call the patch adds at :111 is null-safe via the Objects::nonNull guard in getLoginPredicate (IdentityProviderStorageProvider.java:253), so an ordinary missing alias still returns false.
